d: Jharkhand sthapna divas ke pavan avsar par rajy sarkar dvara svachchhata aur jan-jagrukta ko barhava dene ke uddeshy se 'svachchhata ke lie daur' (ran phor klinlines) ka bhavy aayojan kiya gaya. is karyakram men shamil hueen jharkhand mukti morcha (JMM) ki sansad mahuaa maji ne samast jharkhandvasiyon ko sthapna divas ki hardik shubhkamnaen din aur dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ko shraddha suman arpit kie.
